agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/tokens.py: _TokenType.__getattr__ was creating new token attributes for dunder name lookups (e.g. __deepcopy__, __copy__, __reduce__) instead of raising AttributeError, which broke copy.deepcopy/copy.copy on Token objects with 'TypeError: _TokenType object is not callable'. Added a check so __getattr__ raises AttributeError when the requested name is a dunder (starts and ends with '__'), restoring the intended issue672 fix mentioned in CHANGELOG. Verified with a quick script that copy.deepcopy works on tokens and that normal sqlparse.parse still functions correctly.
